items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: I was asking a lot of questions like, who was better, Jimmy Noon or Tio, you know?

ctx.x: Well, you mentioned a couple of reels back that he was, Bunk was talking about Jimmy Noon, and I wondered if you can remember anything that he said about Jimmy Noon.

I can't remember anything specific. I was asking him about all the clarinet players. Well, of course, at the time, I was caught up in the mythology of New Orleans music, and I was asking a lot of questions like, who was better, Jimmy Noon or Tio, you know? And of course, I realize now it's kind of a silly question in a way, you know, because they're all up there above a certain critical level. And so Bunk would, I guess, say, well, Tio played fine, and yeah, and of course Jimmy played fine, you know? And I mean,…
But he seemed to give the impression that he did play with Jimmy down here?
